Why Victoria businesses miss calls

Victoria serves a wide farming and industrial region known as the Crossroads. Manufacturing employs about 12% of workers, with chemical plants nearby, and food and hospitality 11%. The University of Houston-Victoria adds students. Being close to the coast, the area can see hurricane damage, as it did with Harvey in 2017, and after a storm roofers and insurance agents can be flooded with calls.
